subject.title: [Feature Request] Telegram Channel: Support Thread Binding for Subagent Sessions

question: Should Telegram expose explicit child forum-topic subagent session spawns for `sessions_spawn(thread:true, mode:"session")`, or should Telegram remain current-topic only by default?
rationale: Current main has both Telegram thread-binding primitives and a current-topic default, while related open work argues both for topic-per-subagent workflows and against user-visible internal subagent topic proliferation.

options.title: Approve explicit child-topic spawn
options.body: Sponsor a narrow Telegram capability that permits deliberate subagent child forum topics while keeping ordinary Telegram binding current-topic.

options.title: Keep Telegram current-topic only
options.body: Reject user-visible child-topic subagent spawning for now and close or redirect the direct implementation candidate.

options.title: Defer to broader threading policy
options.body: Block this issue on the broader channel threading policy work before deciding Telegram-specific exposure.

recommendation.title: Approve explicit child-topic spawn
recommendation.body: Sponsor a narrow Telegram capability that permits deliberate subagent child forum topics while keeping ordinary Telegram binding current-topic.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision sits on the core thread-binding architecture introduced in the merged refactor he authored.
